description: Pre-built AI workflow templates for B2B hardware-to-platform businesses

workflows.name: CRM-to-ERP Deal Sync
workflows.description: Deal closes in HubSpot → auto-generate invoice in Exact Online → update all systems
workflows.trigger: Deal stage changes to 'Closed Won' in HubSpot
steps: Monitor HubSpot deal pipeline via webhook for 'Closed Won' events
Extract deal details: company, amount, products, payment terms
Map HubSpot products to Exact Online invoice lines
Create invoice in Exact Online via API
Update HubSpot deal with invoice number and link
Notify finance team of new invoice via Slack/email

workflows.name: IoT Usage Alert → CS Notification
workflows.description: Usage drops significantly → alert CS team with context → suggest intervention
workflows.trigger: Device usage drops >30% compared to 30-day average
steps: Monitor device usage metrics from IoT platform API
Calculate rolling 30-day usage average per customer
Detect significant drops (>30% below average)
Pull customer context from CRM (contract tier, health score, last contact)
Generate alert with suggested CS action based on usage pattern
Send to CS team via Slack channel or CRM task
prerequisites: IoT platform with usage data API

workflows.name: Partner Install → Auto-Provision
workflows.description: Partner submits install request → provision device → setup billing → confirm to all parties
workflows.trigger: Partner submits installation request via portal
steps: Receive installation request from partner portal webhook
Validate request: customer details, location, device type, contract terms
Provision device in IoT platform (assign serial, configure settings)
Create billing record in ERP with correct tier and start date
Schedule installation with field service team
Send confirmation to partner, customer, and internal teams

workflows.name: Usage Data → Invoice Generation
workflows.description: Aggregate monthly usage per customer → calculate tier pricing → generate invoice in ERP
workflows.trigger: Monthly billing cycle (1st of month) or on-demand
steps: Pull monthly usage data per customer from IoT platform
Look up customer contract tier and pricing rules
Calculate billable amount based on usage vs tier
Detect anomalies (usage spikes, zero usage, tier overage)
Generate invoice draft in ERP with line-item detail
Route for finance approval, then auto-send to customer
prerequisites: IoT platform with usage aggregation API

workflows.name: Device Health → Maintenance Ticket
workflows.description: Device reports error or degraded performance → auto-create maintenance ticket → route to nearest technician
workflows.trigger: Device health metric crosses alert threshold
steps: Monitor device health metrics from IoT platform (connectivity, error codes, performance)
Detect when metrics cross predefined alert thresholds
Create maintenance ticket with device details, error code, and diagnostics
Check parts inventory for required components
Route to nearest available technician with matching skills
Notify customer of scheduled maintenance with ETA
prerequisites: IoT platform with health monitoring API
